bio.text: Xavier Becerra is the Democratic nominee for governor of California in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represented Los Angeles in Congress for more than two decades before Gov. Jerry Brown appointed him state attorney general in 2017.
He later served as U.S. secretary of Health and Human Services under President Joe Biden.

sources.title: Democrat Xavier Becerra and Republican Steve Hilton will face off in California governor's race
